title: 岩體節理剪力試驗~Rock-joint shear testing
focus: 以法向條件、粗糙峰破壞與位移歷程區分節理峰值和殘餘抗剪~Separate peak and residual joint resistance through normal boundaries, asperity damage and displacement history
summary: 本課聚焦以法向條件、粗糙峰破壞與位移歷程區分節理峰值和殘餘抗剪。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on separate peak and residual joint resistance through normal boundaries, asperity damage and displacement history. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 法向應力與摩擦~Normal stress and friction
units.title: 法向應力與摩擦~Normal stress and friction
units.mechanism: 節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。線性摩擦包絡是指定應力範圍的近似，外推到低應力可能虛構黏聚力，高應力又可能壓碎粗糙峰。 假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。~Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone. A linear envelope approximates a specified stress range; extrapolation can invent low-stress cohesion or miss asperity crushing under high confinement. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°. Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°.
units.verify: 以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。~Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.
units.failure: 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。~Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.
units.misconception: 兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。~A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄法向應力與摩擦的資料來源與適用條件。以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for normal stress and friction. Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal.

units.anchor: 孔壓與有效法向力~Pore pressure and effective normal force
units.title: 孔壓與有效法向力~Pore pressure and effective normal force
units.mechanism: 水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。名義外加法向荷重不等於節理有效法向力，局部未排水反應也不能用遠處水位直接代替。 假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。 把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。~Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate. Applied normal force is not effective normal force, and a distant water level cannot represent local undrained response. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa. Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa.
units.verify: 將孔壓、法向力及剪力以相同時鐘記錄，檢查排水管線與試體飽和狀態；比較不同速率試驗能否達到同一有效應力路徑，未量到界面孔壓時需明列推估限制。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。~Synchronize pore pressure, normal force and shear and check drainage and saturation; compare whether different rates achieve the same effective stress path, explicitly limiting results when interface pore pressure is inferred rather than measured. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface.
units.failure: 把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。~Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface.
units.misconception: 外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。~Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄孔壓與有效法向力的資料來源與適用條件。將孔壓、法向力及剪力以相同時鐘記錄，檢查排水管線與試體飽和狀態；比較不同速率試驗能否達到同一有效應力路徑，未量到界面孔壓時需明列推估限制。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pore pressure and effective normal force. Synchronize pore pressure, normal force and shear and check drainage and saturation; compare whether different rates achieve the same effective stress path, explicitly limiting results when interface pore pressure is inferred rather than measured.

units.anchor: 定力與定剛度邊界~Constant-load and stiffness boundaries
units.title: 定力與定剛度邊界~Constant-load and stiffness boundaries
units.mechanism: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。實際圍岩介於不同約束情境，兩種試驗曲線不能直接混成同一材料定律。 假設法向剛度kn=2 MPa/mm、剪脹0.3 mm，Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa；未計設備柔度。 把設備的高剛度效應當成節理本身高強度，會在低約束現地高估承載；控制迴路遲滯則可能製造不實峰值或錯誤剪脹曲線。~Dilation moves the normal boundary. Constant-normal-load testing permits movement at fixed load, while constant-normal-stiffness testing increases stress as dilation develops. Actual surrounding rock imposes a specific constraint, so the curves are not interchangeable material laws. With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance. Interpreting high machine confinement as intrinsic joint strength overestimates resistance under low field restraint. Controller lag can also create a spurious peak or misleading dilation curve.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設法向剛度kn=2 MPa/mm、剪脹0.3 mm，Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa；未計設備柔度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance.
units.verify: 以標準件校準設備柔度，核對控制器維持的是力、位移還是剛度；將實際法向應力歷程與目標比較，並由設計者說明試驗邊界如何代表隧道周圍岩體。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把設備的高剛度效應當成節理本身高強度，會在低約束現地高估承載；控制迴路遲滯則可能製造不實峰值或錯誤剪脹曲線。~Calibrate machine compliance with a reference block and verify whether control maintains force, displacement or stiffness; compare actual normal histories with targets and require the designer to justify their representation of surrounding ground. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Interpreting high machine confinement as intrinsic joint strength overestimates resistance under low field restraint. Controller lag can also create a spurious peak or misleading dilation curve.
units.failure: 把設備的高剛度效應當成節理本身高強度，會在低約束現地高估承載；控制迴路遲滯則可能製造不實峰值或錯誤剪脹曲線。~Interpreting high machine confinement as intrinsic joint strength overestimates resistance under low field restraint. Controller lag can also create a spurious peak or misleading dilation curve.
units.misconception: 定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。~Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄定力與定剛度邊界的資料來源與適用條件。以標準件校準設備柔度，核對控制器維持的是力、位移還是剛度；將實際法向應力歷程與目標比較，並由設計者說明試驗邊界如何代表隧道周圍岩體。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for constant-load and stiffness boundaries. Calibrate machine compliance with a reference block and verify whether control maintains force, displacement or stiffness; compare actual normal histories with targets and require the designer to justify their representation of surrounding ground.

units.anchor: 剪脹與幾何攀升~Dilation and geometric climbing
units.title: 剪脹與幾何攀升~Dilation and geometric climbing
units.mechanism: 粗糙峰互相攀升造成剪脹，同時提高切向阻力；隨法向應力增加，峰體可能剪斷而減少幾何攀升。剪脹角是位移路徑斜率，不能當成所有位移階段固定的摩擦增量。 假設剪移2 mm產生法向增量0.2 mm，ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°；此為該段平均角。 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。~Asperities climb over one another, generating dilation and additional resistance. Greater confinement may shear them off and reduce climbing. Dilation angle is a displacement-path slope, not a constant friction increment throughout the test. Assume 2 mm shear displacement produces 0.2 mm normal movement; ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°, averaged only over that interval. Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. Retaining initial dilation after the surface has polished also misrepresents large-displacement residual behavior.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設剪移2 mm產生法向增量0.2 mm，ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°；此為該段平均角。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 2 mm shear displacement produces 0.2 mm normal movement; ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°, averaged only over that interval.
units.verify: 用雙側位移計檢查試件傾斜，逐段求法向對剪向位移斜率；比較剪後表面與碎屑，判定剪脹降低是粗糙峰破壞或儀器轉動，不能只看一支量規。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。~Use displacement gauges on both sides to detect rocking and evaluate incremental slopes; compare post-test surfaces and debris to distinguish asperity damage from instrument rotation rather than relying on one gauge. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. Retaining initial dilation after the surface has polished also misrepresents large-displacement residual behavior.
units.failure: 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。~Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. Retaining initial dilation after the surface has polished also misrepresents large-displacement residual behavior.
units.misconception: 只用單側位移計就能完全排除試件轉動造成的假剪脹。~One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄剪脹與幾何攀升的資料來源與適用條件。用雙側位移計檢查試件傾斜，逐段求法向對剪向位移斜率；比較剪後表面與碎屑，判定剪脹降低是粗糙峰破壞或儀器轉動，不能只看一支量規。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for dilation and geometric climbing. Use displacement gauges on both sides to detect rocking and evaluate incremental slopes; compare post-test surfaces and debris to distinguish asperity damage from instrument rotation rather than relying on one gauge.

units.anchor: 峰值與殘餘強度~Peak and residual resistance
units.title: 峰值與殘餘強度~Peak and residual resistance
units.mechanism: 峰值需要原有咬合或膠結尚未破壞，殘餘強度則對應較大位移後形成的滑動面。隧道附近若已有位移歷史，直接採首次峰值可能不適當，應先辨識設計機制需要哪一段。 假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。 試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。~Peak resistance depends on surviving interlock or bonding, while residual resistance follows development of a sliding surface. Previously displaced ground may not mobilize a first-cycle peak, so the required part of the curve depends on the design mechanism. Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety. Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety.
units.verify: 保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。~Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database.
units.failure: 試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。~Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database.
units.misconception: 試驗曲線的最後一點必定已代表真正殘餘強度。~The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄峰值與殘餘強度的資料來源與適用條件。保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for peak and residual resistance. Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average.

units.title: 剪切面積修正~Shearing-area correction
units.mechanism: 剪切位移增加會減少上下試件的重疊面積，若仍以初始面積換算應力，就把幾何變化混入材料軟化。對不規則天然節理還需考慮實際接觸區，名義重疊不等於真實接觸。 假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。 忽略面積縮小會把實際穩定阻力誤判為軟化，重複做面積修正又會高估強度；兩者在大位移段尤為嚴重並影響殘餘值。~Shear movement reduces specimen overlap, so initial-area stress mixes geometry with material softening. Irregular natural joints also have evolving contact patches; nominal overlap is not the true contact area resisting shear. An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area. Ignoring reduced area can make stable resistance appear to soften, while applying correction twice overestimates strength. Both errors become pronounced at large displacement and bias residual values.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area.
units.verify: 從試件幾何與實測位移逐點重算名義面積，並保存未修正與修正應力曲線；若天然表面接觸範圍未知，說明名義面積定義，不用影像猜出的接觸率任意再放大應力。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略面積縮小會把實際穩定阻力誤判為軟化，重複做面積修正又會高估強度；兩者在大位移段尤為嚴重並影響殘餘值。~Recalculate nominal area at each measured displacement and retain corrected and uncorrected curves; if natural contact area is unknown, state the nominal definition rather than arbitrarily amplifying stress through a guessed contact fraction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring reduced area can make stable resistance appear to soften, while applying correction twice overestimates strength. Both errors become pronounced at large displacement and bias residual values.
units.failure: 忽略面積縮小會把實際穩定阻力誤判為軟化，重複做面積修正又會高估強度；兩者在大位移段尤為嚴重並影響殘餘值。~Ignoring reduced area can make stable resistance appear to soften, while applying correction twice overestimates strength. Both errors become pronounced at large displacement and bias residual values.
units.misconception: 剪切位移增加時，應力仍應永遠除以最初重疊面積。~Shear stress should always use initial overlap area as displacement increases.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄剪切面積修正的資料來源與適用條件。從試件幾何與實測位移逐點重算名義面積，並保存未修正與修正應力曲線；若天然表面接觸範圍未知，說明名義面積定義，不用影像猜出的接觸率任意再放大應力。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for shearing-area correction. Recalculate nominal area at each measured displacement and retain corrected and uncorrected curves; if natural contact area is unknown, state the nominal definition rather than arbitrarily amplifying stress through a guessed contact fraction.

units.anchor: 速率與排水時間~Rate and drainage time
units.title: 速率與排水時間~Rate and drainage time
units.mechanism: 細粒充填的排水時間取決於排水距離和固結係數，剪切太快會改變孔壓而非只改變摩擦。岩石接觸面也可能有速率效應，所以速度比較必須維持相同水文與正向約束。 假設特徵排水距離5 mm、cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s，t=L²/cv=2500 s約41.7 min；此為尺度估算。 將未排水弱化歸因於表面磨耗會選錯殘餘參數，反之緩慢試驗的高阻力也不能代表快速卸荷；缺少孔壓資料時兩種機制很難分開。~Fine infill drainage depends on path length and consolidation coefficient; rapid shearing changes pore pressure as well as friction. Rock contacts may themselves be rate sensitive, so rate comparisons need matched hydraulic and normal boundaries. For assumed drainage length 5 mm and cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s, t=L²/cv=2500 s, about 41.7 min; this is a scaling estimate. Attributing undrained weakening to surface wear selects the wrong residual parameter, while slow-test resistance does not represent rapid unloading. Without pore-pressure records the mechanisms are difficult to distinguish.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設特徵排水距離5 mm、cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s，t=L²/cv=2500 s約41.7 min；此為尺度估算。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed drainage length 5 mm and cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s, t=L²/cv=2500 s, about 41.7 min; this is a scaling estimate.
units.verify: 比較剪切時間與排水尺度並監測孔壓，使用不同速度時保持相同飽和與邊界；試驗方案由專業人員選定，課程時間估算不能替代規範要求或直接成為設備速率設定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將未排水弱化歸因於表面磨耗會選錯殘餘參數，反之緩慢試驗的高阻力也不能代表快速卸荷；缺少孔壓資料時兩種機制很難分開。~Compare shearing duration with drainage scale while monitoring pressure, holding saturation and boundaries constant across rates; specialists select the test program, and this time estimate does not prescribe a machine rate or replace a standard. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Attributing undrained weakening to surface wear selects the wrong residual parameter, while slow-test resistance does not represent rapid unloading. Without pore-pressure records the mechanisms are difficult to distinguish.
units.failure: 將未排水弱化歸因於表面磨耗會選錯殘餘參數，反之緩慢試驗的高阻力也不能代表快速卸荷；缺少孔壓資料時兩種機制很難分開。~Attributing undrained weakening to surface wear selects the wrong residual parameter, while slow-test resistance does not represent rapid unloading. Without pore-pressure records the mechanisms are difficult to distinguish.
units.misconception: 只要試驗速度很慢，就不必再檢查孔壓和排水。~A sufficiently slow test never needs pore-pressure or drainage checks.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄速率與排水時間的資料來源與適用條件。比較剪切時間與排水尺度並監測孔壓，使用不同速度時保持相同飽和與邊界；試驗方案由專業人員選定，課程時間估算不能替代規範要求或直接成為設備速率設定。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rate and drainage time. Compare shearing duration with drainage scale while monitoring pressure, holding saturation and boundaries constant across rates; specialists select the test program, and this time estimate does not prescribe a machine rate or replace a standard.

units.anchor: 粗糙度與尺度差~Roughness and scale dependence
units.title: 粗糙度與尺度差~Roughness and scale dependence
units.mechanism: 小試件可被單一粗糙峰主導，大節理面則包含多種波長與接觸區。量測粗糙度要標明剖面方向和解析度，因為順層與橫層剪切可能呈現不同咬合，不能用一條剖面代表所有方向。 假設同高程差2 mm在10與100 mm基長上，平均坡度分別0.2與0.02；尺度改變使表觀坡度差10倍。 低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。~One asperity may dominate a small specimen, while a large joint contains multiple wavelengths and contacts. Roughness profiles require direction and resolution because interlock differs by shearing direction; one trace cannot represent the entire surface. An assumed 2 mm height change over 10 and 100 mm baselines gives slopes 0.2 and 0.02, a tenfold apparent difference caused by scale. Coarse scanning removes fine asperities while high-resolution noise exaggerates roughness. Combining differently filtered indices can make a processing difference appear to be a genuine difference in shear resistance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同高程差2 mm在10與100 mm基長上，平均坡度分別0.2與0.02；尺度改變使表觀坡度差10倍。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 mm height change over 10 and 100 mm baselines gives slopes 0.2 and 0.02, a tenfold apparent difference caused by scale.
units.verify: 沿預期剪切方向量測多條表面剖面，另以三維掃描查空間差異；報告點距、濾波與試件尺寸，使用經驗粗糙度模型時需明列其適用尺度和法向應力範圍。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。~Measure multiple profiles along expected shear direction and compare three-dimensional scans; report spacing, filtering and specimen size, explicitly bounding the scale and normal-stress range of any empirical roughness model. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Coarse scanning removes fine asperities while high-resolution noise exaggerates roughness. Combining differently filtered indices can make a processing difference appear to be a genuine difference in shear resistance.
units.failure: 低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。~Coarse scanning removes fine asperities while high-resolution noise exaggerates roughness. Combining differently filtered indices can make a processing difference appear to be a genuine difference in shear resistance.
units.misconception: 一條高解析表面剖面足以代表所有方向和尺度的粗糙度。~One high-resolution profile represents roughness in every direction and at every scale.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄粗糙度與尺度差的資料來源與適用條件。沿預期剪切方向量測多條表面剖面，另以三維掃描查空間差異；報告點距、濾波與試件尺寸，使用經驗粗糙度模型時需明列其適用尺度和法向應力範圍。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for roughness and scale dependence. Measure multiple profiles along expected shear direction and compare three-dimensional scans; report spacing, filtering and specimen size, explicitly bounding the scale and normal-stress range of any empirical roughness model.

units.anchor: 量測誤差與強度~Measurement error and strength
units.title: 量測誤差與強度~Measurement error and strength
units.mechanism: 力與面積的不確定性共同控制換算應力，摩擦角又透過非線性反正切求得。只報設備力計精度會漏掉天然表面尺寸、傾斜與法向控制誤差，須以完整誤差鏈說明結果。 假設力標準不確定2%、面積3%，獨立小誤差下應力相對不確定√(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%。 只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。~Force and area uncertainty jointly control stress, while friction angle follows a nonlinear inverse tangent. Load-cell accuracy alone omits natural-surface dimensions, rocking and normal-control error, requiring the complete measurement chain. Assume independent small standard uncertainties of 2% in force and 3% in area; relative stress uncertainty is √(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%. Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. Design may then respond strongly to distinctions unsupported by the measurements.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設力標準不確定2%、面積3%，獨立小誤差下應力相對不確定√(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent small standard uncertainties of 2% in force and 3% in area; relative stress uncertainty is √(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%.
units.verify: 用校準紀錄與重複尺寸量測估計不確定度，檢查面積和位移是否共享同一誤差來源；對關鍵強度參數做上下限分析，只有差異大於量測與試件散布時才主張材料確有變化。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。~Estimate uncertainty from calibration and repeated dimensions, checking shared error sources in area and displacement; bracket strength parameters and claim material differences only when they exceed measurement uncertainty and specimen variability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. Design may then respond strongly to distinctions unsupported by the measurements.
units.failure: 只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。~Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. Design may then respond strongly to distinctions unsupported by the measurements.
units.misconception: 力計精度就是整個節理抗剪應力試驗的不確定度。~Load-cell accuracy equals the complete uncertainty of a joint shear-stress test.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄量測誤差與強度的資料來源與適用條件。用校準紀錄與重複尺寸量測估計不確定度，檢查面積和位移是否共享同一誤差來源；對關鍵強度參數做上下限分析，只有差異大於量測與試件散布時才主張材料確有變化。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for measurement error and strength. Estimate uncertainty from calibration and repeated dimensions, checking shared error sources in area and displacement; bracket strength parameters and claim material differences only when they exceed measurement uncertainty and specimen variability.

units.anchor: 剪切功與試後證據~Shear work and post-test evidence
units.title: 剪切功與試後證據~Shear work and post-test evidence
units.mechanism: 剪切曲線下的面積表示單位面積做功，包含摩擦、粗糙峰破壞和設備儲能，並非全轉成可量測的熱。試後表面和碎屑讓能量解釋有物理依據，也揭露試體是否走錯破壞面。 假設平均剪應力0.6 MPa、滑移5 mm，W/A=τδ=3000 J/m²；未分離可回復儲能。 試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。~Area under the shear stress-displacement curve represents work per unit area, shared among friction, asperity damage and machine energy rather than entirely measured heat. Post-test surfaces and debris test that interpretation and identify unintended failure planes. With assumed mean shear stress 0.6 MPa and slip 5 mm, W/A=τδ=3000 J/m², without separating recoverable stored energy. Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均剪應力0.6 MPa、滑移5 mm，W/A=τδ=3000 J/m²；未分離可回復儲能。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean shear stress 0.6 MPa and slip 5 mm, W/A=τδ=3000 J/m², without separating recoverable stored energy.
units.verify: 數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。~Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error.
units.failure: 試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。~Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error.
units.misconception: 剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。~All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄剪切功與試後證據的資料來源與適用條件。數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for shear work and post-test evidence. Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以法向條件、粗糙峰破壞與位移歷程區分節理峰值和殘餘抗剪需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why separate peak and residual joint resistance through normal boundaries, asperity damage and displacement history requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°.
教學量化備忘：假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa.
教學量化備忘：假設法向剛度kn=2 MPa/mm、剪脹0.3 mm，Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa；未計設備柔度。~Teaching quantitative note: With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance.

教學量化備忘：假設剪移2 mm產生法向增量0.2 mm，ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°；此為該段平均角。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume 2 mm shear displacement produces 0.2 mm normal movement; ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°, averaged only over that interval.

教學量化備忘：假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。~Teaching quantitative note: Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety.

教學量化備忘：假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area.
